intro.p1: ViaHost AI Developer VPS are delivered ready to work with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Git, Docker, Python, Node.js and the usual development tools.
intro.p2: You simply connect your own Anthropic or OpenAI account, or enter your own credentials or API key where it applies.
intro.p3: The server stays available permanently even when you shut down your computer, so development sessions, agents, processes, Docker, builds and projects keep running 24/7.

0.q: What is an AI Developer VPS?
0.a: A virtual private server delivered with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Docker, Git, GitHub CLI, Node.js LTS and Python already installed on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. You connect over SSH, type claude or codex, sign in with your own account and start coding. Because it is a server, your agents and sessions keep running 24/7.

1.q: Are the Claude or ChatGPT subscriptions included?
1.a: No. Anthropic and OpenAI subscriptions and API usage are not included in the VPS price. You use your own account, subscription or API key. ViaHost provides the infrastructure, the operating system, the installation, the initial configuration and the development tools.

2.q: Do I have to sign a long contract to get this price?
2.a: No. Billing is monthly and renews monthly, with no commitment. The price shown is the real monthly price; there are no promotional prices tied to 12, 24, 36 or 48-month contracts.

3.a: All AI Developer VPS are provisioned in Germany, on AMD EPYC 7402P hosts with ECC memory and NVMe storage, virtualized with Proxmox VE. Other locations cannot be selected until dedicated AI Developer infrastructure exists in other countries.

4.q: Do my agents keep working if I close my laptop?
4.a: Yes. The VPS is always on and tmux is preinstalled. Run ai-session to open a persistent tmux session, start Claude Code or Codex inside it, and detach. When you reconnect from any device, everything is still there.

5.q: Are any API keys stored on the server image?
5.a: No. The master template contains no Anthropic or OpenAI API keys, GitHub credentials or private tokens. Each VPS is generated clean and you authorize your own accounts on first use.

6.q: How is the server secured by default?
6.a: UFW firewall with only SSH open, Fail2ban protecting SSH, automatic security updates and no root password login. Docker publishes container ports on 127.0.0.1 by default, so a development database is not exposed to the Internet by accident.

7.a: Yes. You can move between AI Starter, AI Developer and AI Multi-Agent from your control panel. Upgrading bills only the monthly difference; the disk is never reduced.

why.kicker: Why a VPS for Claude Code
why.title: Claude Code is at its best when nothing interrupts it.

0.d: A refactor or a test-fix loop can run for a long time. On a laptop it dies with the lid; on a VPS inside tmux it simply keeps going.

1.t: Pick it up from any device
1.d: Start a task at your desk, check it from your phone over SSH, review the diff from a tablet. The session is the same one.

2.d: Open several tmux windows, one Git worktree each, and let different Claude Code sessions work on different branches without stepping on each other.

3.t: A sandbox that is not your laptop
3.d: Give Claude Code a machine where it can install packages, run Docker and execute tests without touching your personal computer.

4.d: Git, GitHub CLI, Node.js LTS, Python 3, build-essential, ripgrep, jq and Docker. Claude Code finds what it needs on the first command.

5.d: A fixed IPv4 in a German datacenter for webhooks, staging previews and SSH tunnels to your development servers.

how.title: Four commands to a working Claude Code server

0.d: Use the IP and the one-time password from your delivery email.

1.d: A tmux session in ~/projects that survives disconnects.

2.d: Claude Code is installed globally and already on your PATH.

3.d: Claude Code prints a sign-in link: open it in any browser, approve, and paste the code back. A Claude subscription or an Anthropic API key both work.

which.title: Which plan for Claude Code?
which.p1: AI Starter is enough for one Claude Code session and a couple of projects. AI Developer is the comfortable choice when Claude Code runs next to Docker, a database and your builds. AI Multi-Agent is for several Claude Code sessions in parallel, Claude Code plus Codex together, or heavy test suites.
which.p2: All of them are billed monthly with no commitment, and you can change plan from the panel.

0.q: Is Claude Code already installed on the VPS?
0.a: Yes. Claude Code is installed globally and verified after provisioning: the claude command must answer before the server is delivered. You only have to sign in with your own account.

1.a: No. The Claude subscription or the Anthropic API usage is not included in the price of the VPS. You use your own Anthropic account, subscription or API key. ViaHost is not affiliated with Anthropic.

2.q: How do I log in to Claude Code on a server without a browser?
2.a: Run claude and use /login. Claude Code shows a URL that you open on any device; after approving, you paste the code back into the terminal. No browser is needed on the server.

3.q: How do I keep Claude Code running when I disconnect?
3.a: Run it inside tmux. The ai-session command opens or re-attaches a persistent session; detach with Ctrl-b d and Claude Code keeps working. Reconnect later from any device and run ai-session again.

4.q: Can I run several Claude Code sessions at once?
4.a: Yes. Use one tmux window per session and one Git worktree per task. For several parallel sessions with Docker and tests we recommend AI Developer or AI Multi-Agent.

5.q: Can I use Claude Code from my phone?
5.a: Yes. Any SSH client on iOS or Android works. Because the session lives in tmux on the server, a mobile connection dropping does not interrupt Claude Code.

6.q: How do I update Claude Code?
6.a: Run ai-tools-update to upgrade Claude Code and Codex CLI to their latest versions. No sudo is needed: the tools live in a prefix owned by the developer user.

0.q: Is OpenAI Codex CLI already installed?
0.a: Yes. Codex CLI is installed globally and verified after provisioning: the codex command must answer before the server is delivered.

1.q: Is my ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API usage included?
1.a: No. OpenAI subscriptions and API usage are not included in the VPS price. You sign in with your own ChatGPT account or use your own OpenAI API key. ViaHost is not affiliated with OpenAI.

2.q: How do I sign in to Codex on a server without a browser?
2.a: Run codex login --device-auth: Codex prints a link and a code that you approve from the browser on any of your devices. Alternatively, sign in with an API key using codex login --with-api-key.

3.q: Can Codex keep working after I close the SSH connection?
3.a: Yes. Run Codex inside tmux with the ai-session command and detach with Ctrl-b d. The process keeps running on the server and you can re-attach from any device.

4.q: Can I run Codex and Claude Code on the same VPS?
4.a: Yes, both are preinstalled. For running them simultaneously with Docker and tests, AI Multi-Agent is the plan designed for it.

5.q: Where is the Codex VPS hosted?
5.a: In Germany, on AMD EPYC 7402P hosts with ECC memory and NVMe storage. AI Developer VPS are currently only available in that location.

6.q: How do I update Codex CLI?
6.a: Run ai-tools-update to upgrade Codex CLI and Claude Code to their latest versions. Global npm installs work without sudo for the developer user.
